subject: [RFC PATCH 07/18] mm: free the pages waiting for a grace period before isolation fails

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where the Linux kernel fails to allocate memory due to pages waiting for a grace period after migration. The issue arises when alloc_contig_range() and offline_pages() migrate folios out of a range, but some pages are still waiting for a grace period. To resolve this, the patch introduces a new function rcu_free_sync(), which frees every waiting folio, including those taken off the lists by a work. This allows the kernel to retry memory allocation after freeing the waiting pages. The approach taken is to add a check in offline_pages() to free waiting pages before retrying memory allocation.
